usageNotes: Use this endpoint to enumerate all USB devices physically connected to a specific cluster node — useful before configuring USB passthrough to a VM or LXC container. The node must be online and reachable, and the caller requires the Sys.Modify privilege at the root path (/). The response includes bus/device numbers, vendor/product IDs, speed, and optional serial numbers that are needed when adding a usb device to a VM config.

examples.summary: List all USB devices on node pve1

tips: Use vendid and prodid from the response when configuring USB passthrough by vendor/product ID (usb: host=vendid:prodid) — this is more stable than bus/device numbers which can change on reboot.
If serial is present, prefer it for unique device identification when multiple identical USB devices are attached to the same node.
The usbpath field (when present) allows port-based passthrough (usb: host=bus-port) — useful when you need a specific physical port regardless of which device is plugged in.
